crm_notes: Summary: Live commerce platform; heavy, short bursts during flash sales (Black Friday style windows). Primary concern: throughput at burst--requests pile into queue and P95 latency spikes beyond SLA.

Discovery (2025-11-12): Product + infra team. Use-case: moderating chat + model-based rerank for product recommendations during live streams. Needs sub-300ms p95 for chat in peak bursts; target 1000 req/s sustained during events with short 10k req/s spikes (10-30s).
POC kickoff (2025-12-01): 2-week stress POC. We ran hosted-api baseline then recommended Dedicated pool + autoscaling/burst plan. POC attempted simulated flash sale traffic (10k RPS spikes).

POC results (2025-12-15): Observed queue growth and worker saturation at ~4k concurrent requests on hosted config. Average per-token cost within range, but tail latency grew to 1.2s p95 and 2.8s p99 for chat completions under spike. Team flagged queuing as unacceptable.

SE notes: KV-cache and batching improvements reduced per-token compute but didn't remove scheduling contention during very short spikes. Suggested options: 1) Reserved Dedicated pool sized for peak with warm standby nodes; 2) Hybrid: edge-prefetching and local caching + Redwood dedicated fallback. Both require commitment and CAPEX/ARR trade-offs.

Security review (2026-01-10): Asked for VPC private endpoints, KMS integration, audit log retention 1y. Security team put extra controls; asked for SOC2 report and encryption at rest proof. We shared security FAQ and SOC2 link (drive doc).

Procurement (2026-01-25): Finance flagged uncertain ROI for Dedicated commit; requested usage-based fallback. Procurement paused pending budget clarity. Quote provided; finance asked for 'burst credits' or usage cap model.

Competitive pressure (2026-02-04): CompetitorAI Cloud proposed an autoscaling multi-region solution with 'instant burst' and pay-as-you-go pricing; promised 5-minute warm-up SLA for spikes. Customer prioritized pricing model and minimal ops over guaranteed tail latencies.

Internal champion: Lead SRE (Samir) left the company in Jan; no clear replacement. Without engineering sponsor, project stalled. CDM commented: 'we can't justify heavy reserved commit without someone to own capacity.'
Recent outreach (2026-02-20): AE follow-up—left voicemail, emailed pricing + smaller Dedicated pilot option. Cc: Rafael (SE). No reply from buyer side; likely budget freeze for Q1/Q2.
Quoted objection and verbatim: 'We need the spikes covered, but finance won't sign a big annual commit for a problem we only hit a few times a year.'
Next suggested tactics: propose short-term burst credits pilot (3 months), provide more detailed cost/latency modeling for Dedicated vs competitor, re-engage once new SRE/eng lead onboarded.
Decision status: Stalled -> leaning closed-lost to CompetitorAI Cloud due to price/auto-scale promises and procurement freeze. Keep as churn-watch; re-open in next fiscal cycle.
